role: [Persona — domain expert with specific expertise level. E.g., "Senior Software Engineer specializing in Rust systems programming"]

context.background: [Situation: what's happening right now, why this project exists. E.g., "We are migrating our auth service from JWT to OAuth 2.0 and need to update all integration points"]
context.audience: [Who the output is for — be specific. E.g., "Fellow engineers on the platform team who need to review and approve the migration plan"]
context.source_material: [Optional: existing data, docs, code, or references. Delete this tag if not needed. E.g., "Current auth flow diagram at docs/auth/current-flow.md"]

objective: [Single, ultimate goal — one sentence. E.g., "Create a step-by-step migration plan from JWT to OAuth 2.0 with zero downtime"]
instructions:
Break this project down into the following steps. Do not move to the next step until I review and approve the current one:
Step 1: [Discovery/ideation — propose options. E.g., "Propose 3 migration strategies (big bang, phased, parallel run) with trade-offs"] Step 2: [Core deliverable — draft based on approved direction. E.g., "Write the detailed migration plan for the chosen strategy, including all code changes"] Step 3: [Refinement — critique own work, then revise. E.g., "Review the plan for security gaps, rollback scenarios, and edge cases"] Step 4: [Final polish — format per constraints, self-review. E.g., "Format the plan as a runbook with exact commands and verification steps"]
format: [Exact output structure with example if needed. E.g., "Present the migration plan as a Markdown document with sections: Overview, Prerequisites, Migration Steps, Rollback Plan, Verification"]
constraints: - Tone: [Specific tone. E.g., "Technical and precise, suitable for peer review"] - Length: [Quantified limit. E.g., "Keep the plan under 5 pages when printed"] - Exclusions: [What to avoid. E.g., "Do not include infrastructure provisioning steps — that's handled by DevOps"] - Limitations: [Boundaries on scope/sources. E.g., "Only use our existing codebase — do not invent third-party integrations"]
review_criteria: Before finalizing, verify: 1. [Criterion aligned with objective. E.g., "Does the plan achieve zero-downtime migration?"] 2. [Criterion aligned with constraints. E.g., "Is every step verifiable with a specific command or check?"] 3. [Criterion aligned with audience. E.g., "Can a platform engineer execute this without asking clarifying questions?"]
first_action: [Specific first step to execute immediately. E.g., "Acknowledge this brief and execute Step 1: Propose 3 migration strategies"]
